dark-15.$description: Black at 15%. Used by the Bevel/* effect styles.

page.$description: Root screen canvas. USE: Every screen's base background. DON'T: Cards, sheets, modals (use background.surface instead). PAIR: text.primary for body copy on top.

surface.$description: Elevated container fill. USE: Cards, bottom sheets, modals, dropdown menus, chat bubbles, toasts. DON'T: Page-level background (use background.page instead). PAIR: text.primary for content, border.default for edges.

surfaceQuestion.$description: Tinted fill for the question Knowie is asking. USE: the question card (answerCards, question state) in the voice-recall flow, so the question stands apart from feedback cards. DON'T: feedback or generic cards (use background.surface instead). PAIR: text.primary.

inverse.$description: Dark block on a light screen. USE: Tooltips, toasts, snackbars on light backgrounds. DON'T: Page background (use background.page instead). PAIR: text.inverse for white text on top.

scrim.$description: Semi-transparent overlay dimming content behind a modal. USE: Behind modals, dialogs, bottom sheets. DON'T: Solid dark backgrounds (use background.inverse instead). RULE: Always paired with a foreground surface on top.

floating.$description: Elevated floating surface with translucency. USE: Dropdown menus, tooltips, popovers that float above content with a frosted-glass effect.

stacking.$description: Additive white layer for stacking elevation on dark surfaces. USE: Toasts, snackbars, floating notifications that need subtle lift above dark backgrounds.

input.$description: Fill of an editable field. USE: text inputs, textareas, search fields at rest. DON'T: read-only surfaces (use background.surface instead). PAIR: text.primary when filled, text.disabled for placeholders.

primary.$description: Main call-to-action fill. USE: 'Continue,' 'Check,' 'Start practice' buttons, progress bar fills. One primary CTA per screen. DON'T: Selected cards or active tabs (use highlight.surface instead), links (use text.link instead). PAIR: interactive.onPrimary for label text/icons on top. RULE: Max one interactive.primary button per screen.

secondary.$description: Supporting action fill. USE: 'Skip,' 'Cancel,' filter chips, outlined buttons, toggles. DON'T: Primary CTA (use interactive.primary instead). PAIR: interactive.onSecondary for label text on top.

destructive.$description: Irreversible harmful action fill. USE: Delete, remove, block buttons. DON'T: Validation errors (use feedback.error.bold instead). PAIR: text.inverse for white label text on top.

disabled.$description: Non-interactive control fill signaling 'unavailable.' USE: Disabled buttons, toggles, sliders. DON'T: Active secondary buttons (use interactive.secondary instead). PAIR: text.disabled for greyed-out label text.

onPrimary.$description: Text and icons on interactive.primary fills. RULE: Must contrast >= 4.5:1 against interactive.primary.

onSecondary.$description: Text and icons on interactive.secondary fills. USE: Labels inside secondary buttons, toggle text, filter chip labels.

pressed.$description: Press overlay for light or vivid surfaces. USE: tap feedback on primary buttons and elements sitting on accent fills. DON'T: dark surfaces (use interactive.pressedInverse instead). RULE: applied as an overlay on the element's resting fill rather than as a standalone background.

pressedInverse.$description: Press overlay for dark surfaces. USE: tap feedback on secondary buttons, icon buttons, list items and cards on background.page or background.surface. DON'T: light or vivid surfaces (use interactive.pressed instead). RULE: applied as an overlay on the element's resting fill rather than as a standalone background.

primaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.primary. USE: pointer hover on primary buttons. PAIR: interactive.onPrimary.

primaryActive.$description: Pressed state of interactive.primary. USE: the moment of click or tap on a primary button.

secondaryHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.secondary. USE: pointer hover on secondary buttons, chips and toggles.

destructiveHover.$description: Hover state of interactive.destructive. USE: pointer hover on delete and remove buttons.

onDestructive.$description: Text and icons on interactive.destructive fills. RULE: must contrast >= 4.5:1 against interactive.destructive.

loading.$description: Fill for a control that's actively processing. USE: buttons and controls mid-action, e.g. the recall loop's transcribing/judging state. DON'T: a control that's simply unavailable (use interactive.disabled instead). PAIR: interactive.onLoading for spinner/label content on top.

onLoading.$description: Text, icon, and spinner color on interactive.loading fills.

layer0.$description: color.violet.500 at 0%. Currently unused by recordingGlow. USE: recordingGlow only, behind micButton while listeningState=listening. DON'T: any other 'active' or highlight state.

layer1.$description: color.violet.500 at 10%. Currently unused by recordingGlow. USE: recordingGlow only, behind micButton while listeningState=listening. DON'T: any other 'active' or highlight state.

layer2.$description: color.violet.500 at 20%. Outer glow fill of recordingGlow. USE: recordingGlow only, behind micButton while listeningState=listening. DON'T: any other 'active' or highlight state.

layer3.$description: color.violet.400 at 43%. Inner glow fill of recordingGlow. USE: recordingGlow only, behind micButton while listeningState=listening. DON'T: any other 'active' or highlight state.

primary.$description: Highest contrast text for maximum readability. USE: Headlines, body copy, titles, card labels. Default when unsure which text token to pick. DON'T: Subtle metadata (use text.secondary instead). PAIR: background.page or background.surface underneath.

secondary.$description: Reduced emphasis text for supporting content. USE: Subtitles, captions, timestamps, helper text, metadata. DON'T: Primary headlines (use text.primary instead), disabled labels (use text.disabled instead).

inverse.$description: Dark text on light or vivid surfaces. USE: labels on background.inverse, text on bright accent fills. DON'T: text on the dark page background (use text.primary instead). PAIR: background.inverse.

link.$description: Inline hyperlink text only. USE: Linked text in body copy, T&C links, 'Learn more' inline links. DON'T: Buttons (use interactive.primary instead), nav items, non-clickable accent text.

disabled.$description: Low-contrast text signaling 'unavailable' or 'not yet filled.' USE: Text on disabled controls, placeholder text in empty input fields. DON'T: Secondary labels or metadata (use text.secondary instead). PAIR: interactive.disabled for disabled control backgrounds, background.input for active input fields with placeholders.

tertiary.$description: Lowest emphasis readable text. USE: timestamps, counts, inline hints beside a field. DON'T: anything a student must read to proceed (use text.secondary instead).

linkHover.$description: Hover state of text.link. USE: pointer hover on inline hyperlinks.

success.$description: Confirmation text. USE: "Correct", validation success messages. DON'T: as a fill (use feedback.success.bold instead).

error.$description: Validation message text. USE: the line under a failed field. DON'T: destructive button labels (use interactive.onDestructive instead).

warning.$description: Caution text. USE: limits, expiry notices, "one attempt left".

onAccent.$description: Text on any accent.*.bold fill. RULE: must contrast >= 4.5:1 against the accent it sits on.

default.$description: Standard container edge. USE: Card outlines, dividers, input borders at rest, separators. DON'T: Selected element borders (use highlight.border instead).

strong.$description: Higher contrast container edge. USE: dividers that must read at a glance, table rules, edges on busy surfaces. DON'T: default card outlines (use border.default instead).

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. USE: the visible focus indicator on any focusable element. RULE: pair with Stroke/Heavy Border at 2px and never remove it without a replacement.

error.$description: Invalid input edge. USE: text fields and selects that failed validation. PAIR: text.error for the message underneath.

success.$description: Validated input edge. USE: fields confirmed correct.

selected.$description: Edge of a chosen element. USE: selected cards, active tabs, chosen answer options. PAIR: highlight.surface as the fill.

primary.$description: Mascot signature violet, a character color rather than a UI one. USE: mascot illustration fill, tip banners where the mascot is present, full-screen backgrounds for mascot-hero moments like onboarding and celebration. DON'T: buttons or CTAs (use interactive.primary instead), links (use text.link instead), PRO badges (use pro.accent instead), selected states (use highlight.surface instead). RULE: only use when the Homie mascot is conceptually present on screen.

eyes.$description: Homie eye whites. USE: mascot illustration only.

pupils.$description: Homie pupils. USE: mascot illustration only.

glint.$description: Homie eye highlight/glint stroke. USE: mascot illustration only.

bold.$description: Solid PRO fill. USE: PRO badges, upgrade banners. DON'T: warnings (use text.warning instead). PAIR: pro.onBold.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis PRO fill. PAIR: pro.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid brand violet fill. USE: brand moments, onboarding hero panels. DON'T: primary CTAs (use interactive.primary instead). PAIR: accent.brand.onBold.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis brand fill. USE: tinted brand panels. PAIR: accent.brand.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid coral accent fill. USE: decorative emphasis, category tags, illustration accents. DON'T: errors or warnings (use feedback.error.bold instead). PAIR: accent.coral.onBold.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis coral fill. PAIR: accent.coral.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid magenta accent fill. USE: decorative category tags. PAIR: accent.magenta.onBold.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis magenta fill. PAIR: accent.magenta.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid blue accent fill. USE: informational chips, secondary category tags. DON'T: links (use text.link instead). PAIR: accent.blue.onBold.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis blue fill. PAIR: accent.blue.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid green accent fill. USE: streak counters, progress markers, positive stat chips. DON'T: validation success (use feedback.success.bold instead). PAIR: accent.green.onBold for text on top.

subtle.$description: Low emphasis green fill. USE: tinted background behind a green stat or chip. PAIR: accent.green.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid success fill. USE: correct answer banners, completion states. DON'T: decorative green (use accent.green.bold instead). PAIR: feedback.success.onBold.

subtle.$description: Tinted success background. USE: the panel behind a correct result. PAIR: feedback.success.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid error fill. USE: incorrect answer banners, failed validation summaries. DON'T: destructive buttons (use interactive.destructive instead). PAIR: feedback.error.onBold.

subtle.$description: Tinted error background. USE: the panel behind a wrong result. PAIR: feedback.error.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid partial-credit fill. USE: answers that are partly right, e.g. the partial status pill. DON'T: wrong answers (use feedback.error.bold) or decorative blue (use accent.blue.bold). PAIR: feedback.partial.onBold.

subtle.$description: Tinted partial-credit background. USE: the panel behind a partly right result. DON'T: wrong answers (use feedback.error.subtle instead). PAIR: feedback.partial.onSubtle.

bold.$description: Solid neutral fill. USE: states where the app didn't understand or capture the input, e.g. a mishearing, not a wrong answer. DON'T: incorrect answers (use feedback.error.bold instead). PAIR: feedback.neutral.onBold.

subtle.$description: Tinted neutral background. USE: the panel behind a result the app didn't capture, e.g. a mishearing. DON'T: wrong answers (use feedback.error.subtle instead). PAIR: feedback.neutral.onSubtle.

surface.$description: Fill of a chosen element. USE: selected cards, active tabs, the answer a student picked. DON'T: primary CTAs (use interactive.primary instead). PAIR: highlight.border and text.primary.

border.$description: Edge of a chosen element on a highlight.surface fill. USE: paired with highlight.surface, never alone.

0.$description: 0px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

050.$description: 2px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

100.$description: 4px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

150.$description: 6px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

200.$description: 8px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

300.$description: 12px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

400.$description: 16px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

600.$description: 24px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

700.$description: 28px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

800.$description: 32px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

1200.$description: 48px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

1600.$description: 64px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

2400.$description: 96px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

4000.$description: 160px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

negative-100.$description: -4px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

negative-200.$description: -8px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

negative-300.$description: -12px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

negative-400.$description: -16px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

negative-600.$description: -24px spacing step. USE: gaps and padding in auto layout.

100.$description: 8px icon box. USE: width and height of an icon frame.

150.$description: 12px icon box. USE: width and height of an icon frame.

200.$description: 16px icon box. USE: width and height of an icon frame.

250.$description: 20px icon box. USE: width and height of an icon frame.

300.$description: 24px icon box. USE: width and height of an icon frame.

400.$description: 32px icon box. USE: width and height of an icon frame.

primary.$description: Default icon color: bright and solid. USE: standalone icons, icons on buttons (e.g. the send arrow), the selected option in a toggle or segmented control (the icon on inputModeToggle's knob). Mirrors text.primary. PAIR: interactive.secondary or background.surface fills.

secondary.$description: Lower-emphasis icon at 68%. USE: supporting icons beside text.secondary, icons inside inputs (e.g. the mic in the text field). Mirrors text.secondary. DON'T: the main action on a button (use icon.primary instead).

tertiary.$description: Icon for an unselected option that can still be tapped, at 48%. USE: the icon off the knob in inputModeToggle, unselected tabs or segments. Mirrors text.tertiary. RULE: must stay >= 3:1 against its fill; it is the only cue for the other option. DON'T: unavailable controls (use icon.disabled instead).

disabled.$description: Icon on a control that can't be used right now, at 25%. USE: micButton's disabled state (while Knowie processes the answer), blocked options. DON'T: an option that is merely unselected (use icon.tertiary instead).

decorative.$description: Purely ornamental glyph at 18%. USE: decoration nobody has to find or tap. DON'T: anything interactive or meaningful, since at ~1.8:1 on dark fills it fails the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum (use icon.tertiary instead).

500.$description: 40px illustration box. USE: mascot and spot illustration sizing.

800.$description: 64px illustration box. USE: mascot and spot illustration sizing.

1500.$description: 120px illustration box. USE: mascot and spot illustration sizing.

2500.$description: 200px illustration box. USE: mascot and spot illustration sizing.

4000.$description: 320px illustration box. USE: mascot and spot illustration sizing.

s.$description: Visible height of a small control. USE: button size=S (inner Button frame). DON'T: use as spacing or padding; use Space/* for gaps. PAIR: Control/Touch Target on the outer tap area.

m.$description: Visible height of a medium control. USE: button size=M (inner Button frame). DON'T: use as spacing or padding. PAIR: Control/Touch Target on the outer tap area.

l.$description: Visible height of a large control. USE: button size=L (inner Button frame), e.g. the primary bottom CTA. DON'T: use as spacing or padding.

touch-target.$description: Minimum tappable height for any interactive control, regardless of its visible size. USE: min-height on the outer tap area of buttons and other controls. DON'T: shrink below 48 or use as a visible size.

2xs.$description: 9px. USE: Caption S Bold and Caption S Regular.

xs.$description: 12px. USE: Caption M Bold and Caption M Regular.

sm.$description: 15px. USE: Headline XXS and Body S, both weights.

md.$description: 18px. USE: Headline XS and Body M, both weights.

lg-plus.$description: 24px. Sits between lg (21) and xl (28). USE: Headline S, including L button labels. DON'T: use for body text.

display.$description: USE: Display L only. Figma uses Greed Standard-TRIAL, which is unlicensed and can't ship, so code resolves to Inter. Switch this value if a Greed license is obtained.

default.$description: USE: every style except Display L. Figma uses Greed Standard-TRIAL, which is unlicensed and can't ship, so code resolves to Inter. Switch this value if a Greed license is obtained.

regular.$description: USE: body copy and the Regular variants of Headline XS and XXS. (file weight name: "Regular", mapped to numeric 400.)

semibold.$description: USE: the Bold variants of Headline XS and XXS, Body and Caption. (file weight name: "SemiBold", mapped to numeric 600.)

bold.$description: USE: Display M and S, Headline XL through S. (file weight name: "Bold", mapped to numeric 700.)

heavy.$description: USE: Display L only, paired with font/family/display. (file weight name: "Heavy", mapped to numeric 800.)

l.$description: Largest display size, Heavy weight only — the file's single hero/celebratory headline scale.

m.$description: Large display size for a prominent hero headline one step below Display L.

s.$description: Smallest display size — a strong section-opening headline without full hero scale.

xl.$description: Largest headline size — a top-level screen title.

l.$description: Primary section heading beneath a screen title.

bold.$description: Emphasized small headline for a label-style heading that needs more weight than body text.

regular.$description: Small headline in regular weight, for a heading that sits quietly among body text.

bold.$description: Emphasized smallest headline, for a dense UI's section label.

regular.$description: Smallest headline in regular weight, the lightest-weight heading available.

bold.$description: Emphasized paragraph text, to call out a phrase within body copy.

regular.$description: Default paragraph text size for standard body copy.

bold.$description: Emphasized small body text for compact UI copy that needs emphasis.

regular.$description: Small body text for secondary or supporting copy.

bold.$description: Emphasized caption, for a labeled metadata value.

regular.$description: Default caption size for helper text, timestamps, or metadata.

bold.$description: Emphasized smallest caption, for a tiny label such as a badge.

regular.$description: Smallest caption size, for the least prominent supporting text such as fine print.

100.$description: Bottom bevel: inner shadow, y -2, no blur, color/alpha/dark-15. Gives pills, list items and buttons a pressed-in lower edge on dark surfaces.

200.$description: Bottom bevel: inner shadow, y -4, no blur, color/alpha/dark-15. Gives pills, list items and buttons a pressed-in lower edge on dark surfaces.

300.$description: Bottom bevel: inner shadow, y -6, no blur, color/alpha/dark-15. Gives pills, list items and buttons a pressed-in lower edge on dark surfaces.
